description: 한국환경공단_기후에너지환경부 전기차 충전소 충전건별 충전량 합성데이터 조회서비스 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국환경공단. 전기차의 배터리를 충전할 수 있도록 전기를 공급하는 충전소 및 충전기는 공공기관/민간기업 에서 설치 운영하고 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국환경공단. Its tags are 기후에너지환경부 전기차 충전소, 충전량, 합성데이터, 충전기, 충전시간. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
